author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh bell peppers from the garden are one of summer’s most colorful harvests 🌶️🌿 In this video, we gather ripe peppers and preserve them in jars using a traditional village method, preparing the pantry for the colder months ahead.

The peppers are carefully cleaned and prepared to keep their wonderful flavor, texture, and vibrant color. Each jar captures a little taste of the summer garden, ready to be enjoyed alongside homemade meals throughout winter.

This is traditional village preserving from garden to jar — fresh seasonal vegetables, simple ingredients, and time-honored techniques. A practical and delicious way to make the most of the bell pepper harvest and enjoy homemade garden flavors long after summer is gone. 🫙🌶️🍃
title: From Garden to Jar | Preserving Bell Peppers for Winter   🫙🌶️🍃
